build_StackedBRNN: build a stacked bidirectional RNN module with configurable layers, dropout, and padding support
create_SeqAttnMatch: create a sequence attention matching module that matches sequence Y to each element in X
build_BilinearSeqAttn: build a bilinear attention layer over a sequence X with respect to vector y
create_LinearSeqAttn: create a self attention module that computes softmax scores over a sequence of vectors
run_weighted_avg: run a weighted average computation over a sequence of vectors using provided weights
